entries.message: Security - Harden artwork cache and recovery
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Poster cache IDs use SHA-256, and existing cache rows rekey without losing stored artwork.
Full restore checks the current SQLite database before import and explains recovery options if it is corrupt.
Windows setup lets users choose a dashboard port during install or upgrade and applies it across the service, tray, shortcuts, and optional firewall rule.
Resume and Up Next refresh when the app returns to focus or connectivity; resume cards sort by the latest parsed progress update.
Plex, Emby, and Jellyfin retry an episode mutation once after refreshing stale series indexes.
Sync Activity shows the final provider reason when a destination is skipped.
Local and remote full backups can use independent retention periods.
Backup retention defaults to seven days.
Media detail information begins at the top of its scroll area.
